On the contrary, her effort was clear, cool, logical and dispass ionate.

Mr. Wilcox, the opponent, took issue on the proposition that the ballot protected wages; he asserted that capital governed labor irrespective of franchise, and argued at some length but the audience did not relish his logic and interrupted him (as is said) with much hiss-terical demonstration. Miss Anthony came to his rescue and the debate terminated quietly, Miss Anthony bearing off the honors.
